nodes.label: MySQL socket pinned to aRpCXvFUz to avoid cross-site pairing
nodes.rationale: Local names every database `local` and distinguishes sites only by the MySQL socket, so the wrong socket would silently pair this plugin's files with another site's database while appearing to work. The socket is pinned rather than left to chance, and each harness re-checks siteurl before touching anything.

nodes.label: --web mode runs suites through php-fpm instead of CLI PHP
nodes.rationale: CLI PHP on this machine has no Imagick, so a CLI-only run would silently exercise cwebp regardless of the engine requested. Web mode issues a token-authenticated request to web-runner.php so the suite runs under the site's actual PHP-FPM extensions.

hyperedges.label: run.sh guards against Local's ambiguous db naming and CLI/web PHP divergence
